(1) we present a new privacy policy language based on a formal deontic logic, which allows for a more expressive representation of user privacy preferences, constraints and policies; (2) we introduce a novel trust model for Web sites that enables a user to specify a trust value for each Web site, and use this value to evaluate the trustworthiness of a Web site's privacy policies; (3) we present a novel privacy policy framework that combines the new policy language and the trust model
